face.provenance: Layout from references/landmarks.json (sheet30_front; 1 px = 2.41 mm): mouth 23 px, nose 14 px, chin 40 px below the eye line; eye opening about 24 px wide; brows about 31 px above the eye line, from -9 to +11 px around the eye centre. Eye style, highlights, lashes and expressions from #30 face tiles and #34 (eye controls, blendshape matrix). Values in metres; my estimates where noted.

layout.note: T-031b: positions below the (9 mm lower) eye line; the lower face extends 9 mm (fidelity: mouth, nose, chin 2-4 px high)

strands.note: span 62 / strands to 58 deg, outward 0.3: with the 42 mm eye the lash line and strand tips stay inside the glasses rim (72 deg / 80 deg crossed the frame at the outer corner in face_system_test)

eyes.note: T-031b: openings rounder and larger through the lids (upper edge 43, lower -53 deg), eyes 9 mm lower; radius stays 42 mm: at 44-46 mm the upper lid shell crosses the glasses rim's inner edge (face_system_test 12-24 overlaps per eye). T-031 v2: layered glossy iris (amber centre, brown body, dark limbal ring, lighter lower half), large catchlight upper screen-right plus a small lower one, wet clear coat; r 42 mm standing 13.2 mm out (opening half-width about 30 mm, about 60% of the glasses rim as in #30/#34); lashes as a thick upper line with five curled strands to the outer corner and three short lower strands. large fully open round eyes (#30, #34); two highlights on the same screen side for both eyes (upper right, small lower left); spherical eyeball (gaze rotates it inside concentric lid shells: no intersections), r 36 mm standing 14 mm out of the face (opening half-width 28.5 mm); lids follow 30% of the gaze (eyelid tracking, #34). Tried and rejected (M3): an ellipsoid eyeball (cuts the lids under gaze) and a 48 mm eye 9.5 mm out (large lid hood, off-centre iris on the curved face)

socket.note: T-081: relaxes the socket wall (face_generic/2 opt-in): the sharp folds at the eye corners and below the eye rims (dark specks under skin-felt/2) go from max 92 deg to 40 deg

brows.note: T-031: thick dark-brown felt brows (#30, #34) placed in the skin band between the glasses rim top (z 0.832) and the fringe edge (z 0.846 at the eye centre, 0.832 at the outer end; measured on the 0.7.1 build): at 2.25 r they were under the fringe; T-031b: eyes 9 mm lower (fidelity: eyes 5.6 px above the reference), height 1.57 r keeps the brows at the same place

nose.note: T-031: small round pink nose (#34): a prouder round bump, tinted by the blush nose spot

blush.note: T-031b: rosy round felt blush on the outer cheeks, partly outside the glasses rims (#30 neutral: centre ~48 mm out and ~34 mm below the eye centre)

mouth.note: T-081 (0.11.0): neutral = closed gentle smile with lifted cheeks (owner decisions 2026-11-17/18, ref_34 Neutral): face_generic/2 rest_shape soft_smile (MouthSmile 0.35 + CheekRaise 0.8 baked, lips closed, no teeth or tongue at rest); open smile with teeth and tongue only from MouthWide/JawOpen (Smile, Laugh, Surprise, MouthOpen, talking). Lips a little wider, fuller and pinker than the T-065 candidate (ref_34 mouth tiles, T-059).

blink.note: flatten 0: a flattened closed lid exposes the eye when gaze and blink combine (measured 20-35% at 20 deg); closed_offset 1.2 mm covers the 0.6 mm linear-blend shrink of the 30% lid tracking at 20 deg

expressions.note: presets from the shared library (14 from reference #34); Worried and Curious are optional extras (not in any reference)

face.expressions_reference: #34 blendshape matrix: Neutral, Blink, Left/Right Eye Closed, Squint, Wide-Open, Smile, Frown, Surprise, Sadness, Anger, Confusion, Laugh, Mouth Open

skin.note: T-031: the grey face came from occlusion (protruding eyes, glasses, fringe) on a neutral felt base under the key-left calibration; felt scatters light into creases, so occluded areas shift warm and light instead of grey. Body and face share this material (body_skin), so the tones match. T-031b: + felt light bleed (bleed 0.5, near-neutral bleed tint so the limbs keep their hue) and 32 AO samples (8 left mottled dark patches after denoising); with the shared calibration's front fill. Face-weighted bleed (radius 0.12 m around the nose, 15% on the body): one shared bleed made the limbs 5 L* too bright while the face stayed 4.5 L* dark.

shape.note: face v2 shape on top of the body_generic/2 head fitted to the reference outlines (cheek volume only)
